title: My new game is in the works
author: nundas_yt
selftext:
# 🎮 Boblux — Current Game/Platform Summary

**Boblux** is a Roblox-inspired game platform where players can **play games, create games, customize avatars, socialize, and eventually play together in real-time multiplayer**.

The project has evolved through multiple major updates and is currently around **V8.7**.

# 🏠 1. Boblux Home

The Home page has been redesigned to feel like a modern Roblox-style platform.

It includes:

* **Welcome back** section
* 🔎 Game search
* **Continue** games
* **Recommended For You**
* **Popular Right Now**
* Game thumbnails/icons
* Game ratings and player counts
* 👥 Friends
* Friend requests
* Online status
* Account/profile area
* 🏆 Owner / Admin / OG badges
* Bottom navigation
* Discover
* Avatar
* Create
* Studio
* Friends
* Messages
* Inventory
* Settings

The goal is for the Home page to feel like an actual game platform rather than a simple website.

# 🎮 2. Game System

Boblux supports creating and publishing games.

Games can have:

* Names
* Icons
* Descriptions
* Objects
* Scripts
* Server scripts
* GUIs
* Coins
* Goals
* Players
* Avatars
* Game worlds

There are also built-in example experiences inspired by popular Roblox genres, including original versions of things like:

* **Rovals**
* **Steal a Brainrot-style gameplay**

The intention is that creators can build their own experiences rather than only playing the built-in ones.

# 🛠️ 3. Boblux Studio

Studio has become one of the biggest parts of Boblux.

The current Studio is designed to resemble a professional game editor.

# Top Studio navigation

* Home
* Model
* Avatar
* UI
* Script
* Plugins

# Main tools

* Select
* Move
* Scale
* Rotate
* Transform
* Snap
* Part
* Terrain
* Character
* GUI
* Script
* Import 3D
* Material
* Color
* Group
* Lock
* Anchor

The buttons are intended to perform actual actions instead of simply being decorative.

# 🌳 4. World Building

Creators can build worlds using objects such as:

* Parts
* Trees
* Rocks
* Flowers
* Terrain
* NPCs
* Doors
* Checkpoints
* Coins
* Goals
* Other catalog objects

There is also a large object catalog with **100+ object entries**.

The long-term goal is for these to become increasingly detailed and unique rather than simple primitive placeholders.

# 🔎 5. Explorer

Boblux Studio now has a Roblox-Studio-style Explorer.

It contains things such as:

    Workspace
    Players
    Lighting
    MaterialService
    ReplicatedFirst
    ReplicatedStorage
    ServerScriptService
    ServerStorage
    StarterGui
    StarterPack
    StarterPlayer
    Teams
    SoundService
    TextChatService

Creators can also see the objects they've created in their project.

# 📋 6. Properties

The Studio Properties panel lets creators inspect/edit selected objects.

Current property concepts include:

* Name
* ClassName
* Color
* Position
* Rotation
* Scale
* Anchored
* Locked
* Other object properties

There are also controls for focusing and deleting selected objects.

The plan is to keep expanding this toward a much more complete Roblox-style property system.

# 🖥️ 7. Advanced GUI Builder

Boblux has its own GUI Builder.

Creators can create:

* Frames
* Panels
* TextLabels
* Buttons
* Images
* Progress bars
* Health bars
* Coin counters

It includes:

* Live preview
* GUI hierarchy
* Dragging
* Position editing
* Size editing
* Text editing
* Visibility
* Z-index
* Duplication
* Deletion
* Saving

GUI layouts are saved with the game.

# 📜 8. Scripting

Boblux has a real Lua-based scripting system using **Fengari**.

Creators can write Lua scripts to control their games.

The scripting API currently includes things such as:

    boblux.spawn(...)
    boblux.setName(...)
    boblux.move(...)

and GUI functions such as:

    boblux.gui.create(...)
    boblux.gui.setText(...)
    boblux.gui.setVisible(...)
    boblux.gui.setPosition(...)
    boblux.gui.setSize(...)

# 🖥️ 9. Server Game Scripts

Boblux also has a **one-script server system**.

A creator can use one server Lua script to control major parts of their game.

For example:

    boblux.game.setTitle(...)
    boblux.player.setSpeed(...)
    boblux.player.setJumpPower(...)
    boblux.player.setHealth(...)
    
    boblux.world.spawn(...)
    boblux.world.clear(...)
    
    boblux.ui.message(...)
    
    boblux.on(...)
    boblux.every(...)

This allows a creator to build a game using a relatively small amount of code.

The server also validates scripts and blocks dangerous APIs.

# 🧍 10. Avatars

Boblux has an avatar system.

Players can:

* Have their own avatar
* Customize their avatar
* Appear as Bobluxians
* See other player avatars
* Have avatars appear inside games

The platform also has a 3D avatar editor.

# 👥 11. Friends & Social System

Boblux has a social foundation including:

* Friend requests
* Accept/ignore
* Friends list
* Online presence
* Players currently in games
* Account profiles

The Home page shows friends and friend requests.

# 🏆 12. Badges

There are currently special Boblux account badges:

# 👑 Owner

For the Boblux owner.

# 🔵 Admin

For administrators.

# 🟣 OG

The **founder/early-player badge**.

The OG system is configured around the planned Boblux release:

**September 13, 2026**

Players who create accounts during the first **60 days** of release receive OG permanently.

# 🔐 13. Accounts

Boblux has an actual account system with:

* Registration
* Login
* Logout
* Email registration
* Username/email login
* Password hashing
* Sessions
* Persistent login
* HTTP-only cookies

The server stores account/project information in its database.

# ⚙️ 14. Settings

Settings were added but intentionally kept out of the main Home interface.

Settings includes things such as:

* Appearance
* Sound effects
* Reduced motion
* Sign out

# 📚 15. FAQ / ToS / Privacy

Boblux now has dedicated pages for:

* ❓ FAQ
* 📜 Terms of Service
* 🔒 Privacy Policy
* ⚙️ Settings

They're accessible without cluttering the main Home screen.

# 💾 16. Cloud Projects

Creators can save projects to the Boblux server.

Projects can contain:

    Game name
    Objects
    Scripts
    Server script
    GUI
    Game data

Creators can load their projects again later.

Published games can retrieve their saved project data.

# 📦 17. 3D Import

Boblux Studio has support for importing **GLB/GLTF** 3D models using Three.js.

This is intended to let creators bring models made in programs such as Blender into Boblux.

# 🌐 18. Multiplayer

This is the newest major system.

Boblux V8.7 now has a **real-time WebSocket multiplayer foundation**.

It supports:

* Up to **12 players**
* Player joining
* Player leaving
* Real-time movement
* Remote avatars
* Player names
* Server-authoritative positions
* Multiplayer game sessions
* Shared game state
* Coin synchronization
* Connection status

So the architecture is now moving toward:

    Player A
       ↓
    Boblux Server
       ↑
    Player B

instead of each player being completely isolated.

# Current limitation

The Boblux server is still running locally on:

    127.0.0.1:3000

So **true internet multiplayer between your PC and your friend's PC isn't available yet** until the Boblux server is hosted somewhere reachable by both computers.

# 🎯 The Bigger Vision

The overall goal has become much bigger than just a browser game.

We're essentially building:
